rules.description: Required checklist metadata must be present.
Checklist Artifact ID must be stable and valid.
Checklist item IDs must be unique.
Outcome must use the controlled vocabulary.
Evidence-bearing pass outcomes require an evidence reference.
Evidence references must be resolvable and unambiguous.
Deferred outcomes require an approved exception reference and review point.
Applicable PR checklist sections must be complete.
Baseline readiness items cannot remain failed or not-evaluated.
Release readiness items cannot remain failed or not-evaluated.
Automation output must not claim approval authority.
